column1: # Closed terms at the edges of every primitive, and the literal each normalizes
# to. Read by kernel_normalization_edges_test, which normalizes each with the
# kernel, and by tools/formal/check.sh, which states each as a Coq Example about
# the model's normalizer (formal/coq/Normalize.v) proven by computation. The two
# agreeing on every row is evidence that the model computes what the kernel
# computes on these terms (docs/KERNEL.md 17); neither side reads the other.
# An operand or result written vN:type is the variable of de Bruijn index N,
# whose value no row knows: those rows pin folds that hold for every value.
